episodes.title: Every Single Penny
episodes.summary: When high-powered businessman Jack Wright dies in what appears to be a suicide, his family struggle to make sense of their loss. But the bad times are just beginning for Jack's wife Sally, who faces an earth-shattering revelation about her late husband's will. As friends and family descend on Jack's country estate for the funeral, DCI Hector Morgan investigates – and makes a shocking discovery…

episodes.title: Fight Like Hell
episodes.summary: As the Wright family assess their positions in the wake of Jack's bombshell will, Sally begins the process of a formal challenge – but at what cost? Elsewhere, Gray is pursued by loan shark Eddie, and Rose discloses the truth about her health – while Emily crosses paths with mysterious mechanic Reuben. But everything changes when DCI Morgan reveals the true nature of Jack Wright's demise...

episodes.title: A Tougher Love
episodes.summary: Sally is determined to push ahead with the exhumation, and John forms alliances with Emily and Gray. Meanwhile, DCI Morgan and DS Jones wrestle with some key questions.

episodes.title: Juggling Snakes
episodes.summary: As Sally's legal challenge runs into trouble, her friendship with Arnaud takes a darker turn. With the court date approaching, Rose and Bobby come to a momentous decision.

episodes.title: Salt in the Wound
episodes.summary: A revelation threatens to ruin not only Sally's legal challenge, but the entire bedrock of her family life. Meanwhile, DCI Morgan closes in on his prime suspect.

episodes.title: Treatment
episodes.summary: Sally faces the wrath of an increasingly unhinged Arnaud. Elsewhere, Rose shocks Bobby by taking a huge risk, and DCI Morgan finally brings charges for the murder of Jack Wright.
